root_cause: The new write_paused bridge makes cf_h2_update_local_win shrink the receive window to zero. On unpause, the updater calls nghttp2_submit_window_update without first setting nghttp2's internal local window size; a stream that reaches zero can remain blocked. The later fix calls the missing setter.
findings: The newly connected write_paused state can reduce the HTTP/2 receive window to zero. On resumption, the existing updater submits a window delta without first updating nghttp2's local window state.
